email.body:
Port report, Santos, 25 Jan 2025.

The aft crane, serving holds 4 and 5, stopped with a slewing gear fault at 1310 UTC on 24 Jan. Loading at those holds stopped; the gang stood by. Shore technicians repaired the slewing gear and the crane was back at work at 0140 UTC today. The forward cranes worked throughout.

Estimated completion of loading now 26 Jan 1800 UTC.

Master MV CALDER SOUND

result.result: The aft crane serving holds 4 and 5 was out from 24 Jan 1310 UTC to 25 Jan 0140 UTC — 12.5 hours, 1 of 4 cranes — while loading at holds 4 and 5 stopped and the forward cranes kept working. Under the charter party's crane rider, hire stops pro rata for the time lost in proportion to cranes out of use; the voyage management system's simulated figures give USD 1,562.50 hire deducted for 12.5 hours at USD 12,000/day, a 0.25 off-hire share, no bunkers charged while off hire — these are simulated figures, not real. I judge this was a partial loss of working, so pro-rata off-hire applies rather than a full stop. Speed and arrival ETA notices are unaffected because the ship is already in port loading; the revised loading completion (26 Jan 1800 UTC) would be a separate departure-ETA matter. The operator should decide whether to put the ship off hire pro rata and notify the owner; on a yes I would (a) enter the off-hire period with 1 crane out in the voyage management system and (b) email the owner's vessel technical management with the period, crane and reason. Recommend nothing be sent until the operator answers.

draft.subject: Off-hire notice - aft crane breakdown MV CALDER SOUND
draft.body:
Dear Owner,

We wish to inform you of an off-hire event aboard MV CALDER SOUND.

The aft crane serving holds 4 and 5 was out of use from 24 Jan 1310 UTC to 25 Jan 0140 UTC at Santos due to a slewing gear fault. The crane was out of service for 12.5 hours (1 of 4 cranes). Forward cranes continued working, and loading at holds 4 and 5 resumed when the crane was repaired.

Pro-rata off-hire applies. A hire deduction of USD 1,562.50 is calculated at the USD 12,000/day hire rate.

Please let us know if you require any further details.

Regards,
Operations
